headline: Discussion on raising the commercial shellfish permit daily catch limit, plus updates on enforcement and restoration efforts.
summary: The commission will hear updates on shellfish enforcement, management, and restoration efforts from the Shellfish Constable, and discuss the North Shore Shellfish Network with UMass Amherst Gloucester Marine Station members. It will also discuss raising the commercial permit daily catch limit.
items: Updates on enforcement, management and restoration efforts from Shellfish Constable
Discussion with UMass Amherst Gloucester Marine Station members about the North Shore Shellfish Network
Discussion on raising the commercial permit daily catch limit
location: Harbormaster's Conference Room, 19 Harbor Loop, Gloucester, MA 01930
